description: Returns the full current state of a plan as JSON: rooms (calc_input) and calculation bases, stages with tasks (done or not), who does each stage and contractor labour, materials with qty, unit, calculated qty and formula, prices, packs, store, link, selected tier/option, tools (buy/rent, owned), totals per stage and grand total with 10% reserve, plus an audit list (missing stages or prices, duplicates, suspicious quantities, old prices). Everything the user changed in the plan widget is included. Use it to check calculations, answer questions about the plan or before editing it. Pass view_id (from show_renovation_plan / open_plan) or user_code + plan_id.
name: get_plan
title: Read renovation plan
